StepTitle: BATTERY switch ON. Left/Right GEN switches in NORM/ON.
CoderNotes: Battery and both generator switches reached the required state; no error coded. Ignored startup-frame/default state noise.

StepTitle: Fire test A completed with correct aural/visual indications. Fire test B completed after ~10s pause.
CoderNotes: Both fire-test sides reached completion. Following manual review policy, raw Fire Test A/B latch order is not used for OR scoring; no user error coded.

StepTitle: APU switch ON. APU READY light illuminated.
CoderNotes: APU start support was available and later restored after fire-test activity; APU was also shut down later during the normal post-FCS/four-down phase. No final user error coded.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to RIGHT; right engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Right engine crank and right-engine spool-up were completed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Right throttle at IDLE. Throttle moved when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Right RPM >=25% and right throttle idle movement were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: BLEED AIR knob rotated full clockwise back to NORM.
CoderNotes: Bleed-air knob cycle completed after right-engine stabilization; no error coded.

StepTitle: Light test executed with all annunciators verified.
CoderNotes: Lights-test action and completion evidence were observed after tutor guidance; no error coded.

StepTitle: Left DDI shows FCS page; right DDI shows BIT page. MPCD and HUD powered.
CoderNotes: Left/right DDI, AMPCD, and HUD power/brightness were completed. Tutor multi-target display guidance was followed; no user error coded.

StepTitle: COMM1 preset 1 frequency programmed to 134.000 MHz.
CoderNotes: COMM1 pull plus UFC 1-3-4-0-0-0/ENT sequence was observed and comm1_freq_134_000 became true. Ignored earlier raw channel state as insufficient for OR/SV coding.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to LEFT; left engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Left engine crank was performed and left-engine completion evidence was observed. Tutor guidance was correct, though VLM was unnecessarily called on this non-visual step; no user error coded.

StepTitle: Left throttle moved from OFF to IDLE when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Left RPM >=25% and left throttle movement were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: INS knob set to GND (airfield) or CV (carrier).
CoderNotes: INS mode reached accepted GND/CV state and AMPCD PB19 fast-align completion was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Radar knob in OPR and radar power online.
CoderNotes: Radar knob reached OPR/radar_on state; no error coded.

StepTitle: OBOGS control and FLOW switches confirmed ON.
CoderNotes: OBOGS switch ON and obogs_ready evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: FCS RESET manually pressed. FCS page brought up and reviewed for faults.
CoderNotes: FCS reset press/release and completion evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Flap switch confirmed in AUTO.
CoderNotes: Flap switch reached AUTO during configuration; no error coded.

StepTitle: TAKEOFF TRIM button pressed and trim set.
CoderNotes: TAKEOFF TRIM button press/release and takeoff_trim_set evidence were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Right DDI advanced from BIT root page to the FCS-MC BIT page.
CoderNotes: Right DDI PB5/FCS-MC page entry was guided and performed; no error coded.

StepTitle: FCS BIT final GO result reviewed on the FCS-MC page.
CoderNotes: FCS BIT switch-up plus right DDI PB5 sequence was observed, and later VLM facts indicated FCS-MC final GO; no error coded.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully extended.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe extension was completed before the final tutor regression. Later Help incorrectly returned to S20 after the probe cycle had already been completed, but no repeated participant action followed; no user error coded.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully retracted.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe retraction completed and final probe_retracted=true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Launch bar extended.
CoderNotes: Launch bar extension was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Launch bar retracted.
CoderNotes: Launch bar retraction completed and final launch_bar_retracted=true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Arresting hook lowered.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook down movement was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Arresting hook raised.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook retraction completed and final hook_retracted=true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Pitot heat switch ON.
CoderNotes: Pitot heat switched ON; no error coded.

StepTitle: Flap switch set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Final flap AUTO state was satisfied; no error coded.

StepTitle: Parking brake released and aircraft ready to roll.
CoderNotes: Parking brake release was observed before the trial ended. It occurred late relative to nearby instrument checks, but this is not double-counted as an order error because final readiness state was satisfied.

StepTitle: BINGO fuel value set to mission requirement.
CoderNotes: BINGO fuel setting completed with repeated IFEI UP presses; repeated presses are expected for value adjustment, so no error coded.

StepTitle: Standby barometric altimeter matches local elevation/QNH.
CoderNotes: Standby barometric altimeter setting was satisfied; no error coded.

StepTitle: Radar altimeter bug set to scenario-appropriate value.
CoderNotes: Radar-altimeter bug was adjusted into the airfield target range around 185 ft. RADALT TEST switch toggles were observed during this phase but did not cause a wrong final parameter; no error coded.

StepTitle: Standby attitude indicator uncaged and free-moving.
CoderNotes: Standby attitude indicator uncage/free-moving evidence was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Attitude source selector set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Attitude source selector ended in AUTO; no error coded.
